sentences.text: When defining your path operation function, you pass this task function to the `BackgroundTasks` object using `.add_task()` with the appropriate arguments.
sentences.label: supported

sentences.text: FastAPI will use `jsonable_encoder` to convert the data before sending it.
sentences.label: supported
